reason: The pair and threshold logic holds up, but two claims need fixing. (1) VALUE: in a toy private-rank model (scratchpad pairsim.py; I~N(0.7,0.9)/1000, fitted to the C2 priors; X_S-X~N(muD,1)/1000; 400 x138 copies; 200 S copies; 450 variants; 70 top teams), {S+ins,#37} is never worse than {S+ins,#38} and never worse than {#37,#38}. P(bronze) goes .62->.78 at muD=0.2 and .70->.77 even at muD=-0.3, because S+ins = max(D+I, I) is an option on top of #37. It loses to {#37,#38} only when I<0 AND X_S+I<X, which matches the 5-7% catastrophic case. So the pair choice {S+ins,#37} (twin leaves) is supported. (2) WRONG CLAIM, 'no new rule needed': R4 reads 'delta to the current F1 candidate', and P6 (CONTEXT 26 Sep 09:03) registers the successor threshold as 0.956 = K2 + 0.002. P6 also explicitly bans any 'successor + insertion build (new code after R8, unscored stack)'. Measuring S's mechanism against x138 is a defensible NEW reading, since S+ins keeps the insertion. But it amends P6, the R8 consolidation cutoff and the task's HARD LINE (no lab gate on S; S+ins cannot be submitted by 27 Sep 12:00). It is valid only as E10 v2 with a new user OK logged before 27 Sep 12:00Z and before any S is seen (PC11-03/05/11). (3) FEASIBILITY GAP: S+ins runtime ~ runtime(S) + <=0.85 h. If S is slower than x138 (amanatar-type extra stages), the 8.0 h DIVINS gate can fire on the hidden run. The insertion is then silently SKIPPED, and S+ins degenerates to S + C01, which sits at the bottom of the S copy block. Conditions (iv)-(v) do not catch this. (4) Unconditional value is small. Every near-top public notebook seen so far (amanatar v10, anhadmahajan06) fails P4c, so P(a clean S >= 0.955 is first seen after the OK and before 29 Sep 00:00) is ~0.05-0.15.
fix: Rewrite PC11-06 into E10 v2 as follows. (a) Delete 'no new rule needed'. State: 'E10 v2 amends P6's last sentence and R4's successor reading: for S+ins only, S's own mechanism is measured against x138 (0.953), so S >= 0.955 displayed; a verbatim port keeps P6's 0.956.' Add the precedence line E10 v2 > E10 PORT RULE > f2 > R4, and get a new user OK before 27 Sep 12:00Z, before any S is seen (PC11-03/05/11). (b) Keep the pair {S+ins, #37} and conditions (i)-(v). Add (vi) RUNTIME: the dummy D0 runtime of S on the public test, scaled to the hidden set as in step 0, plus 0.85 h must be <= 7.5 h (1 h margin under the 8.0 h DIVINS gate). Otherwise no S+ins, and P6 applies only at >= 0.956. (c) Add (vii): the S diff does not touch the division stages (PC11-11(3)), so the insertion's x138 lab evidence plausibly transfers. Label the gate 'transfer by construction, not measured on S' (PC11-12). (d) In the [OK] text, spell out the loss case (I<0 AND X_S+I<X, ~5-7%): both finals then sit below all x138 copies, rank > ~650, no medal. Keep S = 0.954 as notify-only with a separate [OK]. (e) Token exp67 -> safetail family in runtime_ledger (PC11-08).
realistic_gain: Conditional on a clean S >= 0.955 appearing in time: in the toy model, P(bronze) rises ~+0.07-0.15 and P(silver) ~+0.1-0.2 vs keeping {#37,#38}. Unconditionally (P(trigger) ~0.05-0.15), that is ~+0.005-0.02 P(medal). The cost is a few agent hours of rule text and tooling before R8, and the finals are untouched (byte-identical rebuild).
